WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    totals.transactions,
    device.deviceCategory
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
),
visitors_with_transactions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM sessions
  WHERE transactions IS NOT NULL
),
first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    MIN(s.date) AS first_visit_date
  FROM sessions s
  WHERE s.fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM visitors_with_transactions)
  GROUP BY s.fullVisitorId
),
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    s.date AS first_transaction_date,
    s.deviceCategory,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.fullVisitorId ORDER BY s.date) as rn
  FROM sessions s
  WHERE s.transactions IS NOT NULL
    AND s.fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM visitors_with_transactions)
)
SELECT 
  fv.fullVisitorId,
  fv.first_visit_date,
  ft.first_transaction_date,
  ft.deviceCategory,
  DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ft.first_transaction_date), 
            PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fv.first_visit_date), DAY) AS days_elapsed
FROM first_visit fv
JOIN first_transaction ft ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId
WHERE ft.rn = 1
ORDER BY fullVisitorId

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    visitStartTime,
    h.hitNumber,
    h.time,
    h.type,
    h.page.pagePath,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY h.hitNumber) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
  AND trafficSource.campaign LIKE '%Data Share%'
  AND h.type = 'PAGE'
),
home_hits AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM sessions
  WHERE pagePath LIKE '/home%'
),
next_pages AS (
  SELECT 
    hh.fullVisitorId,
    hh.visitId,
    hh.pagePath AS homePage,
    hh.time AS homeTime,
    hh.hitNumber AS homeHitNumber,
    np.pagePath AS nextPage,
    np.time AS nextTime,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(np.time - hh.time AS INT64), 1000) AS timeOnHomeSeconds
  FROM home_hits hh
  LEFT JOIN sessions np 
    ON hh.fullVisitorId = np.fullVisitorId 
    AND hh.visitId = np.visitId 
    AND np.rn = hh.rn + 1
),
most_common_next AS (
  SELECT nextPage
  FROM next_pages
  WHERE nextPage IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY nextPage
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
max_time AS (
  SELECT CAST(MAX(timeOnHomeSeconds) AS INT64) AS max_time_seconds
  FROM next_pages
  WHERE nextPage IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  mcn.nextPage AS most_common_next_page,
  mt.max_time_seconds AS max_time_on_home_seconds
FROM most_common_next mcn
CROSS JOIN max_time mt

SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%B', DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH)) AS month_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    SUM(CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  ) * 100 AS add_to_cart_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    SUM(CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  ) * 100 AS purchase_rate
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
UNNEST(hits) AS h
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170331'
  AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type IN ('2', '3', '6')
GROUP BY month_name
ORDER BY MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date))

-- Final answer: percentage rounded to 2 decimal places
WITH new_users AS (
    SELECT 
        fullVisitorId,
        MIN(visitStartTime) as initial_visit_starttime
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170430'
        AND totals.newVisits = 1
    GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
initial_visits AS (
    SELECT 
        nu.fullVisitorId,
        nu.initial_visit_starttime,
        s.totals.timeOnSite
    FROM new_users nu
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
        ON nu.fullVisitorId = s.fullVisitorId
        AND s.visitStartTime = nu.initial_visit_starttime
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
),
subsequent_purchases AS (
    SELECT 
        s.fullVisitorId,
        MAX(CASE WHEN s.totals.transactions > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_subsequent_purchase
    FROM new_users nu
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
        ON nu.fullVisitorId = s.fullVisitorId
    WHERE s.visitStartTime > nu.initial_visit_starttime
    GROUP BY s.fullVisitorId
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
        COUNT(CASE WHEN iv.timeOnSite > 300 AND COALESCE(sp.has_subsequent_purchase, 0) = 1 THEN 1 END),
        COUNT(*)
    ) * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM initial_visits iv
LEFT JOIN subsequent_purchases sp ON iv.fullVisitorId = sp.fullVisitorId

SELECT provider_city,
       SUM(total_discharges) AS total_discharges,
       SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) / SUM(total_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY total_discharges DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
  CAST(year AS INT64) AS year,
  ROUND(temp, 1) AS avg_temp,
  ROUND(CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64), 1) AS avg_wind_speed,
  ROUND(prcp, 2) AS precipitation
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
WHERE stn = '725030' 
  AND mo = '06' 
  AND da = '12'
  AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
ORDER BY year

SELECT 
  latitude,
  longitude,
  PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(CAST(year AS STRING), '-', 
         LPAD(CAST(month AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', 
         LPAD(CAST(day AS STRING), 2, '0'))) AS observation_date,
  AVG(wind_speed) AS avg_wind_speed
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2005' AND '2015'
  AND wind_speed IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY year, month, day, latitude, longitude
ORDER BY avg_wind_speed DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
  CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS date,
  temp AS avg_temperature
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2009`
WHERE stn = '723758' AND mo = '10'
ORDER BY temp DESC
LIMIT 3
SELECT EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM DATE '2018-01-02') as tuesday_dow

SELECT 
  AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, MINUTE)) as avg_duration_minutes
FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` pz ON t.pickup_location_id = pz.zone_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` dz ON t.dropoff_location_id = dz.zone_id
WHERE t.data_file_year = 2016 
  AND t.data_file_month = 2
  AND DATE(t.pickup_datetime) BETWEEN '2016-02-01' AND '2016-02-07'
  AND t.passenger_count > 3
  AND t.trip_distance >= 10
  AND pz.borough = 'Brooklyn'
  AND dz.borough = 'Brooklyn'
  AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime

SELECT 
    t.bike_number,
    SUM(
        ST_DISTANCE(
            ST_GEOGPOINT(t1.longitude, t1.latitude),
            ST_GEOGPOINT(t2.longitude, t2.latitude)
        )
    ) as total_distance_meters
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` t1 
    ON t.start_station_id = t1.station_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations` t2 
    ON t.end_station_id = t2.station_id
GROUP BY t.bike_number
ORDER BY total_distance_meters DESC

WITH monthly_minutes AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE(end_date)) AS month_num,
    subscriber_type,
    SUM(duration_sec) / 60.0 AS total_minutes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE(end_date)) = 2017
    AND subscriber_type IN ('Customer', 'Subscriber')
  GROUP BY month_num, subscriber_type
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    month_num,
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN total_minutes END) AS customer_minutes,
    MAX(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN total_minutes END) AS subscriber_minutes
  FROM monthly_minutes
  GROUP BY month_num
)
SELECT 
  month_num,
  customer_minutes,
  subscriber_minutes,
  ABS(customer_minutes - subscriber_minutes) AS abs_diff_seconds,
  ABS(customer_minutes - subscriber_minutes) / 1000.0 AS abs_diff_in_thousands
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY abs_diff_in_thousands DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  ROUND(MAX(ST_DISTANCE(t.start_station_geom, t.end_station_geom) / NULLIF(t.duration_sec, 0)), 1) AS highest_avg_speed
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` si_start ON t.start_station_id = CAST(si_start.station_id AS INT64)
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` si_end ON t.end_station_id = CAST(si_end.station_id AS INT64)
WHERE si_start.region_id = 14 AND si_end.region_id = 14
  AND ST_DISTANCE(t.start_station_geom, t.end_station_geom) > 1000

WITH under20 AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    SUM(population) AS pop_under_20
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific`
  WHERE year = 2020 AND age BETWEEN 0 AND 19
  GROUP BY country_name
),
total_pop AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    midyear_population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population`
  WHERE year = 2020
)
SELECT 
  u.country_name,
  u.pop_under_20,
  t.midyear_population,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(u.pop_under_20, t.midyear_population) * 100 AS pct_under_20
FROM under20 u
JOIN total_pop t ON u.country_name = t.country_name
ORDER BY pct_under_20 DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    SAFE_CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) AS anxiety,
    SAFE_CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) AS depression
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_country_weekly`
  WHERE country_region = 'United States'
    AND date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01'
),
period1 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(anxiety) AS avg_anxiety_2019,
    AVG(depression) AS avg_depression_2019
  FROM filtered
),
filtered2 AS (
  SELECT 
    SAFE_CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) AS anxiety,
    SAFE_CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) AS depression
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_country_weekly`
  WHERE country_region = 'United States'
    AND date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01'
),
period2 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(anxiety) AS avg_anxiety_2020,
    AVG(depression) AS avg_depression_2020
  FROM filtered2
)
SELECT 
  'United States' AS country,
  p1.avg_anxiety_2019,
  p1.avg_depression_2019,
  p2.avg_anxiety_2020,
  p2.avg_depression_2020,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(p2.avg_anxiety_2020 - p1.avg_anxiety_2019, p1.avg_anxiety_2019) * 100 AS pct_increase_anxiety,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(p2.avg_depression_2020 - p1.avg_depression_2019, p1.avg_depression_2019) * 100 AS pct_increase_depression
FROM period1 p1
CROSS JOIN period2 p2

-- Get all tournament game details for the top 5 markets between 2010-2018
SELECT 
    season,
    round,
    game_date,
    day,
    win_seed, win_region, win_market as winning_team_market, win_name as winning_team_name, 
    win_alias as winning_team_alias, win_team_id, win_school_ncaa, win_code_ncaa, win_kaggle_team_id, win_pts,
    lose_seed, lose_region, lose_market as losing_team_market, lose_name as losing_team_name,
    lose_alias as losing_team_alias, lose_team_id, lose_school_ncaa, lose_code_ncaa, lose_kaggle_team_id, lose_pts,
    num_ot, academic_year
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
WHERE season BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018
    AND (win_market IN ('Gonzaga', 'Kentucky', 'Duke', 'Memphis', 'Florida State')
         OR lose_market IN ('Gonzaga', 'Kentucky', 'Duke', 'Memphis', 'Florida State'))
ORDER BY season, game_date

WITH latest_eval AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group_sequence_number, evaluation_group,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state_code ORDER BY evaluation_group DESC) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population`
  WHERE evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
  GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group_sequence_number, evaluation_group
),
latest_eval_filtered AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group_sequence_number, evaluation_group
  FROM latest_eval
  WHERE rn = 1
),
pop_cond AS (
  SELECT 
    p.state_code,
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.expansion_factor,
    p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
    p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot,
    c.condition_status_code,
    c.reserved_status_code,
    c.site_productivity_class_code,
    c.proportion_basis,
    c.condition_proportion_unadjusted
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c 
    ON p.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
    AND p.state_code = c.state_code
  JOIN latest_eval_filtered lef
    ON p.evaluation_group_sequence_number = lef.evaluation_group_sequence_number
    AND p.state_code = lef.state_code
  WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    AND (
      (c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0)
      OR (c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0)
    )
),
state_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    state_code,
    evaluation_group,
    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN condition_status_code = 1 
           AND COALESCE(reserved_status_code, -1) = 0 
           AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6
      THEN expansion_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted 
           * CASE 
               WHEN proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
               WHEN proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
               ELSE 0
             END
      ELSE 0 
    END) as timberland_acres,
    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN condition_status_code = 1
      THEN expansion_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted 
           * CASE 
               WHEN proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
               WHEN proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
               ELSE 0
             END
      ELSE 0 
    END) as forestland_acres
  FROM pop_cond
  GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group
),
timberland_max AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, timberland_acres as total_acres
  FROM state_acres
  ORDER BY timberland_acres DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
forestland_max AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, forestland_acres as total_acres
  FROM state_acres
  ORDER BY forestland_acres DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
state_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT state_code, state_code_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition`
)
SELECT t.state_code, t.evaluation_group, sn.state_code_name, t.total_acres as timberland_acres, NULL as forestland_acres
FROM timberland_max t
JOIN state_names sn ON t.state_code = sn.state_code
UNION ALL
SELECT f.state_code, f.evaluation_group, sn.state_code_name, NULL as timberland_acres, f.total_acres as forestland_acres
FROM forestland_max f
JOIN state_names sn ON f.state_code = sn.state_code

WITH subplot_sizes AS (
    SELECT 
        c.state_code,
        c.state_code_name,
        c.inventory_year,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot ELSE 0 END), COUNT(CASE WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN 1 END)) as avg_size
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot_tree` pt ON c.plot_sequence_number = pt.plot_sequence_number
    WHERE c.inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
        AND c.condition_status_code = 1
        AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    GROUP BY c.state_code, c.state_code_name, c.inventory_year
),
macroplot_sizes AS (
    SELECT 
        c.state_code,
        c.state_code_name,
        c.inventory_year,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot ELSE 0 END), COUNT(CASE WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN 1 END)) as avg_size
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot_tree` pt ON c.plot_sequence_number = pt.plot_sequence_number
    WHERE c.inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
        AND c.condition_status_code = 1
        AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    GROUP BY c.state_code, c.state_code_name, c.inventory_year
),
subplot_ranked AS (
    SELECT state_code, state_code_name, inventory_year, avg_size,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_size DESC) as rn
    FROM subplot_sizes
    WHERE avg_size IS NOT NULL
),
macroplot_ranked AS (
    SELECT state_code, state_code_name, inventory_year, avg_size,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_size DESC) as rn
    FROM macroplot_sizes
    WHERE avg_size IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 'subplot' as plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, state_code_name, avg_size
FROM subplot_ranked
WHERE rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'macroplot' as plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, state_code_name, avg_size
FROM macroplot_ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY plot_type, inventory_year
SELECT start_position, alternate_bases FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v2_1_1_genomes__chr17` WHERE start_position BETWEEN 43044295 AND 43044320 LIMIT 1

-- Calculate the percentage
WITH accidents_with_persons AS (
  SELECT 
    a.state_number,
    a.consecutive_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_number) as distinct_persons,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.injury_severity = 4 THEN p.person_number END) as severe_injury_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2015` p 
    ON a.state_number = p.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = p.consecutive_number
  WHERE a.month_of_crash BETWEEN 1 AND 8
  GROUP BY a.state_number, a.consecutive_number
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_number) > 1
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN severe_injury_count > 1 THEN CONCAT(CAST(state_number AS STRING), '-', CAST(consecutive_number AS STRING)) END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100 as percentage
FROM accidents_with_persons
SELECT _TABLE_SUFFIX, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_*` GROUP BY _TABLE_SUFFIX ORDER BY _TABLE_SUFFIX

SELECT 
  GeoName,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Year = DATE('2012-01-01') THEN Earnings_per_job_avg END) AS earnings_2012,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Year = DATE('2017-01-01') THEN Earnings_per_job_avg END) AS earnings_2017,
  MAX(CASE WHEN Year = DATE('2017-01-01') THEN Earnings_per_job_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Year = DATE('2012-01-01') THEN Earnings_per_job_avg END) AS increasing_amount
FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_bea_cainc30.fips`
WHERE GeoName LIKE '%, MA'
GROUP BY GeoName
ORDER BY increasing_amount ASC

WITH epa_1990 AS (
  SELECT city_name, ROUND(latitude, 2) as lat_r, ROUND(longitude, 2) as lon_r, AVG(arithmetic_mean) as epa_mean
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.air_quality_annual_summary`
  WHERE year = 1990
    AND parameter_name = 'Acceptable PM2.5 AQI & Speciation Mass'
    AND units_of_measure = 'Micrograms/cubic meter (LC)'
    AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY city_name, lat_r, lon_r
),
openaq_2020 AS (
  SELECT city, ROUND(latitude, 2) as lat_r, ROUND(longitude, 2) as lon_r, AVG(value) as openaq_mean
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.openaq.global_air_quality`
  WHERE pollutant = 'pm25'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM timestamp) = 2020
    AND value IS NOT NULL
    AND value > 0
  GROUP BY city, lat_r, lon_r
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(e.city_name, o.city) as city,
  ROUND(e.epa_mean - o.openaq_mean, 2) as difference
FROM epa_1990 e
JOIN openaq_2020 o ON e.lat_r = o.lat_r AND e.lon_r = o.lon_r
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH earliest_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    parent_id as question_id,
    MIN(creation_date) as earliest_answer_time
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
  GROUP BY parent_id
),
question_data AS (
  SELECT 
    q.id as question_id,
    q.creation_date as question_creation,
    ea.earliest_answer_time,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM q.creation_date) as dow_num,
    FORMAT_DATE('%A', q.creation_date) as day_name,
    CASE WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(ea.earliest_answer_time, q.creation_date, SECOND) <= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as answered_within_hour
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN earliest_answers ea ON q.id = ea.question_id
),
day_percentages AS (
  SELECT 
    day_name,
    dow_num,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(answered_within_hour), COUNT(*)) as percentage
  FROM question_data
  GROUP BY day_name, dow_num
)
SELECT day_name, percentage
FROM day_percentages
ORDER BY percentage DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2

SELECT u.display_name
FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON pa.owner_user_id = u.id
WHERE u.reputation > 10
GROUP BY u.display_name
ORDER BY COUNT(pa.id) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(answer_count) as max_answers FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` WHERE tags LIKE '%python-2.7%' AND tags NOT LIKE '%python-3.x%'

WITH 
-- Condition 1: Question owner
question_owners AS (
  SELECT 
    pq.id AS question_id,
    pq.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pq.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq
),

-- Condition 2: Accepted answerer (only where user_id is not null)
accepted_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    pq.id AS question_id,
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pq.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa ON pq.accepted_answer_id = pa.id
  WHERE pq.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND pa.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
),

-- Condition 3: Answer score > 5 (only where user_id is not null)
high_score_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    pq.id AS question_id,
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pq.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON pa.parent_id = pq.id
  WHERE pa.score > 5
    AND pa.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
),

-- Condition 4: Answer score > 20% of total answer scores for that question AND score > 0
question_total_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    parent_id AS question_id,
    SUM(score) AS total_score
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
  GROUP BY parent_id
),
percent_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    pq.id AS question_id,
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pq.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON pa.parent_id = pq.id
  JOIN question_total_scores qts ON pq.id = qts.question_id
  WHERE pa.score > 0 
    AND pa.score > 0.2 * qts.total_score
    AND pa.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
),

-- Condition 5: Top 3 highest-scoring answers per question
ranked_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.parent_id AS question_id,
    pa.owner_user_id AS user_id,
    pa.score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.parent_id ORDER BY pa.score DESC, pa.id ASC) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  WHERE pa.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
),
top3_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    question_id,
    user_id
  FROM ranked_answers
  WHERE rn <= 3
),

-- Combine all unique (user_id, question_id) pairs
all_associations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, user_id FROM question_owners WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, user_id FROM accepted_answers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, user_id FROM high_score_answers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, user_id FROM percent_answers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, user_id FROM top3_answers
),

-- Get view counts per association (deduplicated by question per user)
assoc_with_views AS (
  SELECT 
    aa.user_id,
    aa.question_id,
    pq.view_count
  FROM all_associations aa
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON aa.question_id = pq.id
),

-- Sum per user and rank
user_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(awv.user_id AS INT64) AS user_id,
    SUM(awv.view_count) AS total_view_count
  FROM assoc_with_views awv
  GROUP BY awv.user_id
  ORDER BY total_view_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
)

SELECT 
  ut.user_id,
  u.display_name,
  ut.total_view_count
FROM user_totals ut
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON ut.user_id = u.id
ORDER BY ut.total_view_count DESC

WITH proteome_agg AS (
  SELECT p.gene_symbol, a.sample_submitter_id, a.sample_type, AVG(p.protein_abundance_log2ratio) as avg_protein_log2ratio
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.quant_proteome_CPTAC_CCRCC_discovery_study_pdc_current` p
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.PDC_metadata.aliquot_to_case_mapping_current` a 
    ON p.aliquot_id = a.aliquot_id
  WHERE a.sample_type IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
    AND p.protein_abundance_log2ratio IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.gene_symbol, a.sample_submitter_id, a.sample_type
),
rna_agg AS (
  SELECT sample_barcode, gene_name, sample_type_name, AVG(fpkm_unstranded) as avg_fpkm
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.RNAseq_hg38_gdc_current`
  WHERE primary_site = 'Kidney' 
    AND sample_type_name IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
    AND fpkm_unstranded IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sample_barcode, gene_name, sample_type_name
),
joined AS (
  SELECT pa.gene_symbol, pa.sample_submitter_id, pa.sample_type,
         pa.avg_protein_log2ratio,
         LOG(r.avg_fpkm + 1) as log_fpkm_plus_1
  FROM proteome_agg pa
  JOIN rna_agg r
    ON pa.sample_submitter_id = r.sample_barcode
    AND pa.gene_symbol = r.gene_name
    AND pa.sample_type = r.sample_type_name
),
gene_corr AS (
  SELECT sample_type, gene_symbol,
         CORR(avg_protein_log2ratio, log_fpkm_plus_1) as correlation
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY sample_type, gene_symbol
)
SELECT sample_type, AVG(correlation) as avg_correlation
FROM gene_corr
WHERE ABS(correlation) <= 0.5
GROUP BY sample_type
SELECT hg38_start, hg38_stop, cytoband_name FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` WHERE chromosome = 'chr1' ORDER BY hg38_start LIMIT 30

WITH 
sorafenib_targets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
  WHERE i.drugID = 157 
    AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
    AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
    AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
),
all_pes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pte.pe_stable_id, pe.uniprot_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pte
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON pte.pathway_stable_id = pv.stable_id
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe ON pte.pe_stable_id = pe.stable_id
  WHERE pte.evidence_code = 'TAS' AND pv.lowest_level = TRUE
),
pathway_pe AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pte.pathway_stable_id, pte.pe_stable_id, ap.uniprot_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pte
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON pte.pathway_stable_id = pv.stable_id
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe ON pte.pe_stable_id = pe.stable_id
  JOIN all_pes ap ON pte.pe_stable_id = ap.pe_stable_id
  WHERE pte.evidence_code = 'TAS' AND pv.lowest_level = TRUE
),
pathway_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    pp.pathway_stable_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pp.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN pp.pe_stable_id END) as a,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pp.uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN pp.pe_stable_id END) as b
  FROM pathway_pe pp
  GROUP BY pp.pathway_stable_id
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ap.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN ap.pe_stable_id END) as total_a,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ap.uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets) THEN ap.pe_stable_id END) as total_b
  FROM all_pes ap
),
chi_sq AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.pathway_stable_id,
    pc.a as targets_in,
    pc.b as non_targets_in,
    tc.total_a - pc.a as targets_out,
    tc.total_b - pc.b as non_targets_out,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      (tc.total_a + tc.total_b + pc.a + pc.b) * 
      POWER((pc.a * (tc.total_b - pc.b)) - (pc.b * (tc.total_a - pc.a)), 2),
      (pc.a + pc.b) * ((tc.total_a - pc.a) + (tc.total_b - pc.b)) * (pc.a + (tc.total_a - pc.a)) * (pc.b + (tc.total_b - pc.b))
    ) as chi_squared
  FROM pathway_counts pc
  CROSS JOIN total_counts tc
)
SELECT 
  pv.stable_id as pathway_stable_id,
  pv.name as pathway_name,
  cs.chi_squared,
  cs.targets_in,
  cs.targets_out,
  cs.non_targets_in,
  cs.non_targets_out
FROM chi_sq cs
JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON cs.pathway_stable_id = pv.stable_id
ORDER BY cs.chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3

health_data AS (

  UNION ALL SELECT '2016', ein, totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2016`
  UNION ALL SELECT '2017', ein, totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2017`

filtered AS (

ranked AS (

    AVG(CASE WHEN exp_rank IN (DIV(cnt, 2) + 1, DIV(cnt, 2) + 2) THEN SAFE_CAST(totfuncexpns AS FLOAT64) END) AS median_expenses

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210102`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
    AND ep.key = 'page_location'
    AND ep.value.string_value IS NOT NULL
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    page_location,
    ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) AS num_segments,
    SAFE_CAST(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(3)] AS STRING) AS fourth_segment,
    SAFE_CAST(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(4)] AS STRING) AS fifth_segment,
    SAFE_CAST(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) - 1)] AS STRING) AS last_segment
  FROM page_views
  WHERE ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) >= 5
),
is_pdp AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%accessories%' 
    OR LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%apparel%'
    OR LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%brands%'
    OR LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%campus collection%'
    OR LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%drinkware%'
    OR LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%electronics%'
    OR LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%google redesign%'
    OR LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%lifestyle%'
    OR LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%nest%'
    OR LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%new 2015 logo%'
    OR LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%notebooks journals%'
    OR LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%office%'
    OR LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%shop by brand%'
    OR LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%small goods%'
    OR LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%stationery%'
    OR LOWER(fourth_segment) LIKE '%wearables%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%accessories%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%apparel%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%brands%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%campus collection%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%drinkware%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%electronics%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%google redesign%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%lifestyle%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%nest%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%new 2015 logo%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%notebooks journals%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%office%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%shop by brand%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%small goods%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%stationery%'
    OR LOWER(fifth_segment) LIKE '%wearables%'
    AS has_category,
    LOWER(last_segment) LIKE '%+%' AS last_has_plus
  FROM classified
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM page_views) AS all_page_views,
  COUNT(*) AS classified_page_views,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_category AND last_has_plus THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pdp_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_category AND last_has_plus THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM page_views)) * 100 AS pdp_percentage_of_all

-- Final query: percentage of users who did not uninstall within 7 days or never uninstalled
WITH installers AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, 
         MIN(event_timestamp) as first_open_ts
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180930'
    AND event_name = 'first_open'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
removers AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, 
         MIN(event_timestamp) as app_remove_ts
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'app_remove'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
user_status AS (
  SELECT 
    i.user_pseudo_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN r.app_remove_ts IS NULL THEN 'never_uninstalled'
      WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(r.app_remove_ts), TIMESTAMP_MICROS(i.first_open_ts), DAY) <= 7 THEN 'uninstalled_within_7_days'
      ELSE 'uninstalled_after_7_days'
    END as status
  FROM installers i
  LEFT JOIN removers r ON i.user_pseudo_id = r.user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status IN ('never_uninstalled', 'uninstalled_after_7_days') THEN 1 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100 as percentage
FROM user_status

WITH events AS (
  SELECT
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_date,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) AS event_date_parsed
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003'
),
-- Find first session date for each user
first_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_date_parsed) AS first_session_date
  FROM events
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
-- Users whose first session was in the week of July 2, 2018 (July 2-8)
cohort_users AS (
  SELECT
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_session_date
  FROM first_sessions
  WHERE first_session_date >= '2018-07-02'
    AND first_session_date < '2018-07-09'
),
-- Assign each cohort user to their Monday-based cohort week
cohort_with_weeks AS (
  SELECT
    cu.user_pseudo_id,
    cu.first_session_date,
    DATE_TRUNC(cu.first_session_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS cohort_week_start
  FROM cohort_users cu
),
-- Get cohort size
cohort_info AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) AS cohort_size,
    cohort_week_start
  FROM cohort_with_weeks
  GROUP BY cohort_week_start
),
-- For each event of cohort users, determine which week it falls in relative to cohort week
user_week_activity AS (
  SELECT
    cw.user_pseudo_id,
    cw.cohort_week_start,
    DATE_TRUNC(e.event_date_parsed, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS activity_week_start,
    DATE_DIFF(DATE_TRUNC(e.event_date_parsed, WEEK(MONDAY)), cw.cohort_week_start, WEEK) AS week_offset
  FROM cohort_with_weeks cw
  JOIN events e ON cw.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e.event_date_parsed <= '2018-10-02'
),
-- Get distinct users active per week offset
user_weekly_activity AS (
  SELECT
    cohort_week_start,
    week_offset,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) AS retained_users
  FROM user_week_activity
  WHERE week_offset BETWEEN 0 AND 4
  GROUP BY cohort_week_start, week_offset
)
SELECT
  CONCAT('Week ', CAST(week_offset AS STRING)) AS week,
  ci.cohort_size AS total_new_users,
  CASE week_offset
    WHEN 0 THEN ci.cohort_size
    ELSE COALESCE(uwa.retained_users, 0)
  END AS retained_users
FROM cohort_info ci
CROSS JOIN UNNEST([0,1,2,3,4]) AS week_offset
LEFT JOIN user_weekly_activity uwa 
  ON ci.cohort_week_start = uwa.cohort_week_start
  AND uwa.week_offset = week_offset
ORDER BY week_offset;
